title: Add audio feedback using custom .wav files
summary: The live upstream head was resumed in the preserved fork PR and reviewed to convergence. Fork-side fixes package the WAV assets, keep asynchronous SND_MEMORY buffers pinned, report playback failure, repair changed-default tests, restore spell-check coverage, and align the review description with the third-party asset provenance. Debug builds and 25 targeted tests pass.

suppressed_findings_rechecked: Installer omission remained valid and was fixed fork-side.
Recurring disk checks/routine success logs were superseded by the author's SND_MEMORY update; fork-side review additionally pinned the asynchronous buffer and retained only failure diagnostics.
Changed defaults invalidated opening-sound test inputs; both affected tests were corrected fork-side.
prior_published_findings_rechecked: Unrelated nuget.config and CalculatorEngineCommon edits are absent from the live head.
XAML formatting, NOTICE attribution, NativeMethods placement, SND_NODEFAULT, and per-event defaults are present on the live head.
prior_review_audit.current_head_finding: SND_MEMORY combined with SND_ASYNC requires the memory buffer to remain valid until playback completes; the fork pins each lazily loaded WAV buffer for process lifetime.

verification.summary: After clearing inherited GIT_CONFIG_* variables that initially broke vcpkg, essentials, PowerToys Run, Settings UI, and Settings.UI.UnitTests builds succeeded. PowerToys.exe, PowerToys.PowerLauncher.exe, and both WAV files exist in the Debug output. Run.wxs parses as XML; a full MSI build was not run.

tests.command: pr-intake and Check Spelling passed on the review branch

test_instructions: Open Settings > PowerToys Run and enable Audible feedback; verify the Opening sound and Closing sound controls become enabled.
Invoke and dismiss PowerToys Run with opening only, closing only, both, and neither selected; verify sound plays only for selected transitions and not on initial cold-start load.
For installed-build validation, build/install the MSI and verify Sounds\open.wav and Sounds\close.wav are deployed beside PowerToys.PowerLauncher.exe before merging.
